create_fixed_tendons_for_spinal_joints: create fixed tendons that group lumbar, cervical, and caudal joints by extend, bend, and twist directions using inertia-weighted coefficients
build_general_actuators_for_tendons: build general actuators for spinal tendons with gain values derived from default joint gain parameters and tendon coefficients
review_add_motors_function: review the add_motors function to understand how it filters out spinal and root joints when creating actuated joint lists
summarize_dog_v2_actuator_setup: summarize how the dog v2 model sets up torque actuators using fixed tendons for spinal regions and direct actuators for non-spinal joints
